description: This file defines a TurnTrackingObserver class for monitoring conversation turns in a pipeline, handling start/end of turns based on user and bot speech frames, with timeout and interruption logic.

classes.name: TurnTrackingObserver
classes.description: An observer class that tracks conversation turns, managing turn states, handling interruptions, timeouts, and emitting turn start/end events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the turn tracking observer with parameters for frame history size and turn end timeout.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update turn state based on frame type.

methods.name: _schedule_turn_end
methods.description: Schedules a timeout to end the current turn.

methods.name: _cancel_turn_end_timer
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled turn end timeout.

methods.name: _end_turn_after_timeout
methods.description: Ends the turn if timeout expires without bot speaking.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles user speech frames, managing interruptions and starting new turns.

methods.name: _handle_bot_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles bot speech start frames, updating state and canceling turn end timers.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles bot speech end frames, scheduling turn end with timeout.

methods.name: _handle_pipeline_end
methods.description: Handles pipeline end or cancel frames, ending active turns.

methods.name: _start_turn
methods.description: Begins a new conversation turn, updating state and emitting event.

methods.name: _end_turn
methods.description: Ends the current turn, calculating duration and emitting turn end event.
